subject.title: WhatsApp session stalls on long model_call: incomplete turn with payloads=0, reply never delivered

question: Should the remaining WhatsApp final-error delivery gap be fixed as a narrow WhatsApp patch now, or folded into the broader cross-channel final fallback contract?
rationale: The source-reproducible gap is narrow, but a maintainer-authored broader contract issue already owns durable final fallback semantics across channels, so automation should not pick the permanent contract shape without maintainer intent.

options.title: Revive narrow WhatsApp fix
options.body: Land or recreate the focused WhatsApp final `isError` delivery change now, then leave the cross-channel receipt/contract work to the broader issue.

options.title: Fold into cross-channel contract
options.body: Keep this issue open under the broader durable fallback delivery work and fix WhatsApp as one conformance case there.

options.title: Wait for release repro
options.body: Defer code work until a release containing PR 102160 still shows WhatsApp silence, accepting that current source still preserves the final-error suppression path.

recommendation.title: Revive narrow WhatsApp fix
recommendation.body: Land or recreate the focused WhatsApp final `isError` delivery change now, then leave the cross-channel receipt/contract work to the broader issue.

likelyOwner.reason: osolmaz is assigned to this issue and owns the linked broader final fallback delivery contract discussion.
